module: Parked vehicles and parking tracking system. On one hand it spawns parked cars on the spots of the level's sites file (city.sites.json via gameplay_city) and teleports them to new spots in front of the player when they move away, relying on an activation pool (core_vehicleActivePooling). On the other hand it tracks a driven vehicle (enableTracking) to detect that it enters, exits or parks correctly in a spot and emits onVehicleParkingStatus. A modder uses it to populate an area with parked cars or for parking missions.
usage:
gameplay_parking.setupVehicles(10)  -- spawns 10 parked cars
gameplay_parking.setParkingVars({precision = 0.9, neatness = 0.5})
gameplay_parking.enableTracking(be:getPlayerVehicleID(0), true)
-- hook: function M.onVehicleParkingStatus(vehId, data) if data.event == 'valid' then ... end end
notes: Default variables (vars): precision 0.8 (precision required to validate parking), neatness 0 (neatness of the generated parked cars), radiusCoef 1 (active radius coefficient, clamped to 0.25..1000 by setParkingVars), baseProbability 0.75, activeAmount math.huge, enableRespawn true.
Internal constants: target radius 50 m, search radius 200 m, search point 200 m ahead, keep-active radius 50 m, radius to keep clear 120 m.
Tracking events (data.event): 'enter', 'exit', 'valid' (valid parking held for 0.5 s), 'invalid', 'none'.

Spot tags (customFields.tags) used: street (enables mapmgr.enableTracking), forwards, backwards, perfect, banned, dayTime, nightTime; probability field. Dynamic vehicle field trafficClearRadius: prevents parked car respawns nearby.
A vehicle with the ignoreParking flag is ignored by insertVehicle.
Inserted vehicles get playerUsable = false, ignoreTraffic and isParked, and are added to the walking mode blacklist.
processVehicles is an alias of activate; getParkingAmount is an alias of getParkedCarsAmount.
Emitted hooks: onParkingVehiclesActivated(parkedVehIds), onParkingVehiclesDeactivated(), onVehicleParkingStatus(vehId, data).
Outside onUpdate, the logic does not run if the system is inactive, has no sites, has physics off or is in big map mode.

debugLevel.desc: Debug level: > 0 teleport and filtering logs; >= 1 draws the spots around the tracked vehicle; >= 2 draws the corners; >= 3 draws the search point and the circles.

setSites.desc: Sets the site data (parking spots) used, replacing those of the level. Accepts a file path, or a valid sites table (with parkingSpots); otherwise resets to nil.

data.desc: Path of a .sites.json file or sites table.

setState.desc: Enables or disables the parking system. On activation, loads the default sites if needed and initializes the focus point (gameplay_traffic.getFocus()).

getState.desc: Indicates whether the system is active.

getParkingSpots.desc: Returns the collection of parking spots (sites.parkingSpots: sorted, objects...), loading the sites if necessary.

returns.desc: Collection of spots, nil without sites.

moveToParkingSpot.desc: Places a parked vehicle on a spot: chooses the direction (forwards/backwards tags, otherwise using neatness), adds a random offset and rotation unless the perfect tag, turns the ignition off, frees the old spot, may change the paint, and updates the mapmgr tracking.

lowPrecision.desc: Passed to moveResetVehicleTo (used when the vehicle is not ready).

checkParkingSpot.desc: Indicates whether a spot is usable for a parked vehicle: existing, within the focus distance window, free (no vehicle, not banned, no vehicle on it), outside the trafficClearRadius radii, suitable size (neither too small nor too large: ratio >= 0.5).

minDist.desc: Minimum distance to the focus (m, default 0).

maxDist.desc: Maximum distance to the focus (m, default 1e12).

returns.desc: true if the spot is suitable.

findParkingSpots.desc: Finds the spots in a ring around a position, sorted from nearest to farthest.

filterParkingSpots.desc: Filters in place a list coming from findParkingSpots: removes banned spots, then depending on filters: standardSize (width <= 3, length <= 8), checkVehicles (no vehicle on it), useProbability (spot probability × baseProbability × day/night coefficient according to the time and the dayTime/nightTime tags). Default: {useProbability = true}.

getRandomParkingSpots.desc: Returns a sorted list of valid spots with a random bias in favor of those closest to the origin position. Widens the radius until there are enough spots or maxDist is reached.

targetCount.desc: Number of spots wanted; nil or <= 0 = maxDist radius and automatic minimum.

forceTeleport.desc: Forces a parked car to teleport to a new random free spot nearby. Without a valid spot, sends it off the map via gameplay_traffic.forceTeleport. Has no effect if enableRespawn is false or if the car has ignoreForceTeleport.

scatterParkedCars.desc: Teleports all parked cars (or those provided) to random spots; falls back to forceTeleport when no spot is suitable.

enableTracking.desc: Enables parking tracking for a driven vehicle (also enables the system). Creates the tracking data: inside, preParked, parked, event, maxDist 80 m, parkingTimer, isOversized...

autoDisable.desc: If true, tracking stops at the first parking validation.

disableTracking.desc: Stops the parking tracking of a vehicle.

getTrackingData.desc: Tracking data of all tracked vehicles, by id.

getCurrentParkingSpot.desc: Id of the spot where a vehicle is correctly parked. With active tracking, returns parkingSpotId if preParked; without tracking, searches for the nearest spot (15 m) that contains the vehicle with the precision vars.precision.

setParkingVars.desc: Merges parking variables (resets first if reset). A radiusCoef resets the active radii; an activeAmount updates the vehicle pool.

data.desc: precision, neatness, radiusCoef, baseProbability, activeAmount, enableRespawn.

reset.desc: true to return to the default values before merging.

setActiveAmount.desc: Sets the maximum number of active (visible) parked cars; nil = unlimited.

getParkedCarsAmount.desc: Number of parked cars managed; with activeOnly, capped by activeAmount. Alias: getParkingAmount.

activeOnly.desc: true to count at most activeAmount.

getParkedCarsList.desc: List of the ids of the managed parked cars.

getParkedCarsData.desc: Data per parked car: parkingSpotId, activeRadius, randomPaint, searchFlag...

insertVehicle.desc: Adds a vehicle to the managed parked cars: creates the 'autoParking' pool if needed, makes it unusable by the player, associates it with its current spot if any and enables mapmgr tracking. Ignored if obj.ignoreParking.

removeVehicle.desc: Removes a vehicle from the managed parked cars (does not delete it from the world).

deleteVehicles.desc: Deletes the last parked cars from the world (all by default).

amount.desc: Number to delete, starting from the end of the list.

activate.desc: Activates a group of vehicles as parked cars (inserts them), then emits onParkingVehiclesActivated. Disables the system if there are no sites, no vehicles or none inserted. Alias: processVehicles.

deactivate.desc: Disables the system: clears the lists, deletes the pool and emits onParkingVehiclesDeactivated.

setupVehicles.desc: Spawns parked vehicles on random spots (vehicle group of type propparked, or options.vehGroup). First deletes the current parked cars unless keepCurrent. When the group has spawned, onVehicleGroupSpawned calls activate.

amount.desc: Number; -1 or nil = trafficParkingAmount setting (0 = auto between 4 and 16).

returns.desc: false if the number is zero, if the group is empty or if there are no spots (without bypassChecks).

resetAll.desc: Resets everything: disables, forgets the sites, clears lists and tracking, deletes the pool and restores the default variables.

onVehicleGroupSpawned.desc: core_multiSpawn hook: activates the group when it is named 'autoParking'.

onVehicleResetted.desc: Hook: when the player vehicle is reset/teleported, forces a search for spots near the player (near respawn mode).

onVehicleDestroyed.desc: Hook: removes the vehicle from the parked car and tracking lists, and frees its spot.

onVehicleActiveChanged.desc: Activation pool hook: marks a deactivated parked car for teleport; on its reactivation, teleports it if another vehicle (100 m from a player, 20 m otherwise) is nearby.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame. Updates the parking tracking (enter/exit/valid/invalid events), periodically searches for spots in front of the player and recycles one parked car per frame to a new spot out of the player's range.

onSerialize.desc: Hook before Lua reload: returns the state (active, parked cars, tracking, variables). With options.despawnVehicles, also captures the cars' spawn data (except options.exceptVehicleId) then deletes them.

onDeserialized.desc: Hook after Lua reload: respawns the stored cars if options.respawnVehicles, reactivates the parked cars, restores the tracking, the variables and the state.
